divergences.old: Reading --project and --repo context from the first git remote on the connection's host in `git remote -v` order, which is sorted by remote name
divergences.toil: origin is offered first, then the other remotes in that order, and the first on the connection's host wins. The two differ only when origin and a remote whose name sorts before it (mirror, fork) are both on the host
divergences.why: origin is the clone's own remote, so it's the least surprising one to act on when two remotes point at the same server.

divergences.old: "Could not determine Bitbucket project/repo. Pass --project and --repo, or run <old CLI> config init." (and the project-only form for create-repo and create-prs)
divergences.toil: The same first sentence, then "or set project and repo on the connection", with a fix naming the env vars; checked by core before the command runs, so for list-prs it comes before a bad --created-after is reported
divergences.why: toil has no config init; an error must point at something the user can do.

divergences.old: git current-pr with no Bitbucket baseUrl or token returning { message: "Requires Bitbucket config. Available after <old CLI> config init." }
divergences.toil: The same success with a message, now "Requires Bitbucket config. Available after toil connections add."; a connection that exists but lacks pat also adds a CONFIG_INCOMPLETE warning naming the key
divergences.why: toil has no config init, so the message names the command that sets a connection up.

divergences.old: list-prs, list-comments paging until isLastPage is true, stepping by start + limit when a page has no nextPageStart, with no limit on the number of pages
divergences.toil: Paging stops when isLastPage is true or a page has no nextPageStart, and after 1,000 pages (100,000 items) fails with HTTP naming the list and a fix to narrow it
divergences.why: A server that never says isLastPage would otherwise be read forever; Bitbucket sends nextPageStart on every page that isn't the last.
